title: Qualify inference through the commercial plug host
goal: Make local-release inference qualification exercise the supported core-plus-commercial GPU-fabric topology when explicitly configured, with authenticated host and real request evidence, while retaining the native Candle path.

reuse.reason: The supported external engine path existed but the qualification gate only admitted in-process Candle audit rows. The implementation extends that gate with the existing authenticated bus contract and host logs, without adding another inference engine or downloader.
reuse.searched: Inspected core's existing local-release inference acceptance and both repositories' PlaneBus integration; the commercial repository already ships susi-plug-host and LocalEnginePlaneBusPlug, while core already owns isolated runtime setup, cleanup, semantic answer checks, and native Candle evidence.
